confidence.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
confidence.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_answers, list_clarity_corner, get_booking_options · Private data: get_firm_overview, get_booking_options, find_401k_plan · Public sink: get_booking_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_answers, list_clarity_corner, get_booking_options · Private data: get_firm_overview, get_booking_options, find_401k_plan · Public sink: get_booking_options

confidence.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
